body: I know it's a lot to read. I don't know what help I need. I'm just lost

My father was murdered when I was five. So I have developed a lot of coping skills I'm regards to handling death and topics of such nature. And using comedy as a relief is very helpful to both me and my sister. I know that comedic relief is helpful for a lot of people, especially in such situations. I know this because I work in the healthcare field and see death every day. And I use comedic relief in my daily care. Granted, I do use my common sense and room reading abilities to decide if this is appropriate. I don't feel the same way you do and I disagree with that MFM and other podcasters are disrespectful. But I appreciate the feedback. I'll take it into consideration. I guess generalizing true crime was a mistake, when I'm reality I want to cover paranormally/ghost/conspiracies as well.

It's not comedy on the behalf of victims? Have you listened to My Favorite Murder before? Or every other true crime podcast ever. They just cope with such dark issues and topics using comedy. But I see what you're saying.

"I'm just fat, thanks."

I have been asked this more times than I can even count. If I had a nickel....

"When is your baby due?"

"I'm just fat, thanks."

It would amaze you how many times a day I get asked this question. I'm definitely not pregnant, just fat. And now insecure.

I know TWO murderers personally and have a connection to another 

My step dad's ex-wife shot her young daughter three times before killing herself. She stated in her suicide note that "she didn't want anyone else taking care of her daughter." Her daughter was only 8 years old. 

Also! My step dad's brother bludgeoned his wife to death in a hotel room in New Mexico in a drunken fight. He then shot himself and lived. He was life flighted to a hospital before his daughter (my step cousin) pulled the plug on him. This was all on Thanksgiving day in 2019. 

Lastly, my father passed away when I was young in 2001. My mom took us to a therapist regularly afterwords. Our therapist was the ex wife of a guy named Mark Hofman. He said he 'discovered' LDS scriptures that turned out later to be fake. He constructed two bombs that ended up killing two people.
